used with не before the verb, or alone

examples.trans: I've never been to the sea.

уйти.gloss: to leave, to go away (on foot)

meanings.note: Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to leave, to go away (on foot)', paired with 'уходить'.

meanings.en: to calm down, to settle down

Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to calm down', paired with 'успокаиваться'.
